name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-CNC
notes: High-level CNC cell coordinator. It normalizes read-only controller evidence and can now query real GRBL status and send GRBL's own real-time control bytes (status query, feed hold, cycle resume, soft reset) over a real serial connection; LinuxCNC or another controller retains real-time trajectory, limits, spindle and safety authority - this never streams a G-code program. Interlocks (door/E-STOP) are always re-read live immediately before cycle_start_resume/a new job is gated - no cached snapshot is ever reused for a real safety decision, and (v0.0.9) the live read itself now happens AFTER the blocking GRBL status query completes, not before it, so a real E-STOP/door event during that query is never missed. A real short/zero-byte serial write is reported as not executed, never as a false success; v0.1.0: this now also requires an exact, real int byte count equal to the command length - a None/bool/mismatched-but-real return value from a non-conforming serial-like implementation is no longer silently trusted as a confirmed write either.
